chapter_theme: The single closing stanza of Kanjamalai Siddhar's song: the form of the name is itself attainment, and seeking it out and becoming clear in it is release; the form of discipline is the seed, and everywhere the eternal substance becomes certain.
structure_note: One stanza, 2292, separated from ch116 by the editor's split; it is the twenty-fifth and last stanza of the song and should be read as its conclusion, answering the head unit 2267 (the feet of the Supreme) with the name.

2292.reading: The form of the name is itself attainment; is it not release to seek that out and become clear in it? The form of discipline is the seed; everywhere the eternal substance becomes certain.
2292.nuance: நாம சொரூபம் may be the Lord's name, whose utterance 2268 commanded, so that the stanza makes the name itself the siddhi and release; or it may be Vedanta's நாமரூபம், the world of name and form, in which case the stanza says the attainment is in the very appearance, as 2291 found the self-light within the faculties' play. நேம சொரூபம், the form of observance or discipline, as the seed (வித்து) is the second half's balancing claim, that practice is the seed of what everywhere becomes certain. நிரந்தர வத்து, the eternal substance, is Vedanta's term.

links.note: 2268 commands the listener to utter the rare name of Siva among four imperatives; 2292 closes the song by making the form of the name itself the attainment and its clarified seeking release. The name that was one practice at the opening is the whole at the close.

The Puranamalai says that those who say 'breath', 'heart', 'the release called silence' and 'speech' do not know the Lord's name; Kanjamalai says the form of the name is itself attainment and its seeking release. Both make the name the thing the methods miss, on the reading that நாம சொரூபம் is the Lord's name; if it is Vedanta's name-and-form the two verses are about different things.

source_issues: The chapter holds one stanza because the editor's split of the 25-stanza song fell after 2291; 2292 is the song's close and belongs with ch116.
